items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: Well, Mutt, I know Mutt, too.

ctx.x: I bought a tenor van jewel. It cost $150 there. And learned that the first band that I started playing with when I bought the van jewel, it was Jack Carrey's band.
Oh, yeah. I knew his brother Mutt, but I never knew Jack Carrey.
Well, Mutt, I know Mutt, too. Well, I started playing with Jack. I played with Jack a very long time. Then, jumps around and played with Chris Kelly.
